# release DOI

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:releaseDoi`](gmeow-releaseDoi.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/releaseDoi>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The Digital Object [`Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) (DOI) assigned to a software release — typically minted through DataCite, Zenodo, or a similar PID registry. Non-functional: a release may carry multiple DOIs from different registrars ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
